title: Took the duplicate-code tool to 225+ engineers in two time zones
summary: I presented the duplicate-code tool twice at the September technical sharing event, once for India and once for teams outside India, to more than 225 people in total.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a talk, not an intervention.
the_call: Run the session twice so teams in other time zones could join live.
what_i_did: Presented the tool and took questions in both sessions.
what_changed: 225+ attendees; follow-up questions turned into engagements with teams.

quotes.text: In total 225+ attended in both sessions of technical sharing event
Thanks to Dattatreya Vellal for accommodating and sharing
